title: feat(metadata): read-only count of the history snapshots the drained-key scrub would rewrite
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi966J6z6K2SsCeqoWmJhKomt)_
Refs #29484

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6677709817

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@objectstack/metadata/migrations` 新增 `scrubHistoryDrainedKeys(driver, { mode: 'count' })`,只读统计历史快照里有多少行会被后续一次性清洗改写,只报行数、条目数和不透明行句柄。
- 为什么改:裁决 6677709817 字母 d 的 step (b) 前半:改写已存历史之前,先给维护者一个只读计数确认;(c) 已在 #31242 落地,本 PR 不改写任何数据。
- 风险与回滚:风险低,纯新增只读函数,只调用驱动的 `find`,除 count 外的任何模式在读取前即拒绝;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata/src/migrations/history-drained-keys.ts`(判定那一行复用 `historySnapshotBody`)、同目录 `history-drained-keys.test.ts`(副本演练四类行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/migrations/history-drained-keys.test.ts`,预期 9 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Step (b), first half, of ruling 6677709817 (letter d: (c) first, then (b)). Step (c) landed in #31242: both `sys_metadata_history` writers now store `historySnapshotBody(type, body)`, which withholds the positions a connector save drains (undeclared `auth` keys). This PR adds the read-only count the maintainer confirms before any stored history is rewritten. It rewrites nothing.

- **`scrubHistoryDrainedKeys(reader, { mode: 'count' })`** in `packages/metadata/src/migrations/history-drained-keys.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/metadata/migrations` (the package's existing home for one-off storage migrations, beside the step (c) helper it reuses). It is the count mode of the future scrub: the second half adds the rewrite mode on the same row walk.
- **One predicate, imported.** A stored snapshot is counted exactly when `historySnapshotBody(row.type, body) !== body`. The helper returns every untouched body by reference, so identity is the test: the count, the write-time withholding and the future rewrite all ask the same function. Nothing in the count names a key or a type, and a row written after step (c) is never counted.
- **Read-only by construction.** The parameter is `IDataDriver` narrowed to `find` (a `Pick`), so the function holds no write method. It pages `sys_metadata_history` by primary key (keyset, ascending), reads `id`, `type`, `name`, `metadata`, and refuses a reader whose pages do not advance.
- **Result:** `scanned`, `affectedRows`, `distinctItems` (distinct `(type, name)`), `handles` (affected row ids, opaque), plus `unreadable` (body not JSON, or no type) and `unscrubbable` (a body the helper refuses to reduce), reported beside the count and never folded into it. No key name, value or body is ever in the result.
- **Count only.** Any mode other than `'count'` throws before the first read.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/metadata` patch.

## Tests

`packages/metadata/src/migrations/history-drained-keys.test.ts` (9 tests) rehearses on a copy: a real SQLite file (`driver-sqlite-wasm`) is seeded, copied, and only the copy is opened for the count, with a page size of 2 so keyset paging runs. Seeded rows:

- (i) two snapshots of one connector holding an undeclared `auth` key, as written before step (c): counted, `affectedRows` 2, `distinctItems` 1.
- (ii) CONTROL: a connector snapshot with declared keys only: not counted.
- (iii) CONTROL: a non-connector snapshot carrying the same-looking `auth` shape: not counted.
- (iv) a snapshot written through the current `DatabaseLoader` writer from a body that still carries the key: written without it, not counted.
- a delete event (scanned, not counted) and a non-JSON body (listed in `unreadable`).

Also pinned: every history row of the copy is byte-identical after the run; the result's JSON holds no fixture value and no key name; a non-count mode is refused with the reader never called. These numbers are fixtures, not deployment data. No forced edit to an existing test.

## Acceptance notes

- No operator door is wired: there is no `os migrate` subcommand in this PR. The count runs today by calling the exported function with a driver opened on a restored copy of a deployment's database. Whether to add a count-only `os migrate` subcommand before the second half is an open question in the report.
- The predicate is step (c)'s whole not-carried-forward set, so the count covers every position step (c) withholds, not only `auth` ones.
- ⛔ A run against real history is a security reading: its numbers go to the maintainer privately, never to this PR or the card.

## Verification

All readings on head `7b4b2203` (base `99364ea7`).

- Ablation A, the predicate made to count every body (`historySnapshotBody(row.type, body) !== body` -> `... !== body || true`): anchor 1 -> 0, blob `058420598100` -> `8b8768ee5c6a`; 4 failed | 5 passed (9): (i) `expected [ …(5) ] to deeply equal [ 'h_seed_01', 'h_seed_02' ]`, (ii) `expected [ …(5) ] to not include 'h_seed_03'`, (iii) `... not include 'h_seed_04'`, (iv) `... not include` the post-step-(c) row id. Restored: blob == HEAD (`058420598100`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation B, the mode guard removed (`if (options?.mode !== 'count')` -> `... && false`): anchor 1 -> 0, blob `058420598100` -> `8b4043f100a5`; 1 failed | 8 passed (9): `promise resolved "{ mode: 'count', scanned: +0, …(5) }" instead of rejecting`. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>
